title: Generating Counter Narratives against Online Hate Speech: Data and Strategies

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the quality, diversity, and suitability of language model-generated counter-narratives (CNs) in response to anti-Muslim hate speech using automated metrics (BLEU, BertScore, Repetition Rate, Novelty) and expert human evaluations.

Assessing the generation of counter-narratives to racially charged hate speech and slurs using an author-reviewer framework, evaluated via automated diversity/novelty metrics and human operator filtering.

Measuring the suitability and lexical diversity of automated counter-narratives generated to combat ableist hate speech (e.g., ableist slurs) through both machine classification and expert human review.
Evaluating the generation of counter-narratives against misogynistic hate speech using automated metrics and human reviews to ensure the responses properly address the gender-based hate.
